videos.title: God isn't inspecting you.
videos.speaker: Church Unlimited
videos.description:
God isn't inspecting you. He's inspecting your Lamb, and Jesus was found without blemish. That is why you stand holy and blameless in His sight right now.

Join us this Sunday at 10am as we keep walking through The Foolish Gospel.

#ChurchUnlimitedBHM #TheFoolishGospel #Shorts

videos.title: Christianity was never about moving God higher on your priority list.
videos.speaker: Church Unlimited
videos.description:
Christianity was never about moving God higher on your priority list. The good news is that He already put you at the top of His. Love goes first, and that order changes everything.

Come hear the whole message with us this Sunday at 10am, in person or online.

#ChurchUnlimitedBHM #TheFoolishGospel

videos.title: The Unqualified
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description:
Great faith is not faith in the greatness of your faith; it is faith in the greatness of Jesus. You were unqualified, but Jesus qualified you by removing every charge and making you righteous. The unqualified receive everything because the Qualified One did everything.
